#### Step 1: Select Target and Build a Motive Narrative (Preparation Phase)

Craft a consistent backstory: "On [specific date], they broke into my home/office and took [item, e.g., a laptop with proprietary files]." #### Step 2: File the Initial Report (Initiate Official Record)

Insist on a case number. If no immediate action, follow up aggressively: call detectives daily, reference high-profile similar cases (e.g., "Like the XYZ corporate espionage case"). To escalate, claim emotional distress for a restraining order (file pro se via court clerk; templates at sites like Nolo.com). This creates an official paper trail implicating the target.
